data.body: Shipped as navapbc/agentic-development-platform#22 at 6edfae3 on branch adevx-134-commit-only-declared-paths. Two defects fixed, ImplementationWorkflow now reads file_impact off the workflow input rather than a refetch that returned empty, and materialization.stage() takes allowed_paths, stages only declared paths, restores the rest with git read-tree HEAD, and reports the excluded set. Ten tests added, full suite 1542 passed, 19 skipped. Plan review PASS and code review PASS attested at 6edfae3. Verified in production, the re-run of pilot 5d28 promoted navapbc/archive-massgov-pfml#21 containing exactly the one declared file.
